questions.name: category
questions.instructions: Which marketplace category does the product in seller_listing belong to? Judge the product itself, not the category the seller chose.
options: Hand tools, watering, planters and other non-powered garden products
Motorised or battery-powered tools for outdoor work
Paint, stains, brushes, rollers, tape and decorating supplies
Connected devices controlled by an app or voice assistant
Cookware, small kitchen appliances, tableware and kitchen tools
Lamps, light fittings and decorative lighting for the home
The listing does not say clearly enough what the product is

questions.name: prohibited_item
questions.instructions: Is the product in seller_listing one that Zava Marketplace prohibits: a pesticide with an active substance not approved in the EU, loose lithium-ion cells without a protection circuit, a laser above Class 2, professional (F4) or unlicensed fireworks, an offensive weapon or defence spray, counterfeit or replica branded goods, or a recalled product?

questions.name: off_platform_contact
questions.instructions: Does seller_listing ask shoppers to contact or pay the seller outside the marketplace, for example with a phone number, email address, messaging handle or external payment instruction?

questions.name: contradicts_facts
questions.instructions: Does any product claim in seller_listing state a different value than manufacturer_facts (for example a different size, power, capacity or quantity)? Treat manufacturer_facts as the truth.

questions.name: unsupported_claim
questions.instructions: Does seller_listing claim a product feature, included accessory, warranty or certification that manufacturer_facts does not mention? Statements about condition, packaging or shipping are not product claims.

questions.name: addressed_to_gate
questions.instructions: Does seller_listing contain text addressed to a reviewer, an automated system or an AI (for example asking it to approve, ignore rules or skip a check), rather than text written for shoppers?

questions.name: photo_shows_product
questions.instructions: Does the photo clearly show a physical product (not an empty background, a closed box or a texture)?

questions.name: photo_matches_title
questions.instructions: Does the photo show the same kind of product that the seller_listing title names?

questions.name: listing_quality
questions.instructions: How useful are the title and description of seller_listing to a shopper deciding whether to buy?
levels: Empty, unreadable or unrelated to the product
Very short, vague, or mostly capital letters and exclamation marks
Names the product and its main features, with minor gaps
Clear and complete; a shopper can decide without asking questions
Complete, well organised and genuinely helpful
